title: Life insurance proceeds - federal income tax basics
facts: Life insurance death proceeds paid to a beneficiary because of the insured person's death are generally excluded from the beneficiary's federal gross income.
Interest paid on retained or delayed life-insurance proceeds is generally taxable.
Different tax rules can apply to transfers of policies for value and other special circumstances.
Estate-tax inclusion is a separate issue from whether the beneficiary owes federal income tax on the death benefit.
